svg.title: From the car to the folding roof
svg.desc: The ordinary 2010 2.9 roof spans the cabin. Its drive, side linkages and stowage well sit behind the occupants, ahead of the rear boot. The manual front latch meets the fixed header. Frame members support the fabric and rigid rear glass; one motor drives both side gearboxes. The cover conceals the stowage well, while side pans collect runoff. Numbered parts: 1 Windscreen header; 2 Frame and front latch; 3 Fabric and lining; 4 Rigid heated rear glass; 5 Motor and two shafts; 6 Side gearboxes and rods; 7 Cover and stowage well; 8 Side pans and drains. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
